message: 寝不足の原因

name: Sasami
message: 「Cock-a-doodle-doo」

name: Azel
message: 「Yaaawn...」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa! That's a huge yawn!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bet she couldn't sleep and stayed up super late」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up. I was merely reading a book」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like Lord Synn had trouble falling asleep too」

name: Azel
message: 「You as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「A noise woke me up in the middle of the night. Guess it was just my imagination, though. I fell right back asleep after」

name: Azel
message: 「That sounds like a perfectly good night's sleep」

name: Paqy
message: 「No way, man, it took him a whole thirty seconds to conk out. Compared to usual, that's tossing and turning big time」

name: Synn
message: 「Do I really fall asleep that fast?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, the second you get under the covers and close your eyes, you're already out」

name: Azel
message: 「Y-You! Have you been peeking at this man while he sleeps!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Sometimes. He's super cute. Wanna watch together?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I have no desire to see that!」

name: Azel
message: 「Sluuuurp」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Having that again?」

name: Azel
message: 「Be quiet. Vandine Jelly tastes awful, but it suffices」

name: Synn
message: 「You really ought to eat a proper breakfast」

name: Azel
message: 「This suffices」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, you can have half of my fried egg」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I don't want it」

name: Sally
message: 「Then I'll take i--」

name: Azel
message: 「Nom, nom」

name: Sally
message: 「Azel, you meanie!」

name: Azel
message: 「This was given to me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um... you look kind of sleepy」

name: Paqy
message: 「She was up late with Master Synn」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Whaaaat!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't go telling weird lies like that」

name: Azel
message: 「I was merely reading a book until late」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Oh, I see. Right, of course. Ahaha」

name: Azel
message: 「It's not... as though I couldn't fall asleep because I'm under the same roof as this man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I didn't even ask about that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel borrowed a book called 'Introduction to Photography' yesterday, and she's totally absorbed in it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... Must be nice being so carefree」

name: Paqy
message: 「Totally」

name: Azel
message: 「He certainly lacks any sense of crisis」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? When did everyone turn against me!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Azel-chan sure looks sleepy today~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Apparently she stayed up late reading a book」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That's a classic excuse, isn't it, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you pinning this on me?」

name: Eddie
message: 「If it's a guy looking sleepy, it's definitely from jerking off too much. Are girls the same?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go die」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Is that true, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Again, why are you passing this to me?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm. Not even flustered, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「The reason I am sleepy has nothing to do with you or Nanaka」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nothing to do with me, sure, but it might have something to do with Nana-chan」

name: Azel
message: 「Incomprehensible. Do you understand, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you talking about, ahaha」

name: Sacchin
message: 「There's still time, Nana-chan. Go for it」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but do your best, Nanaka! I'm rooting for you」

name: Azel
message: 「Do your best」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaaaah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's probably fine... It's not like the two of them are going out together or anything...」
